features.description: Goal-gap triage and child-plan configuration. Configures the already-shipped nested-orchestration substrate (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/nested_orchestration.py`, plan `2026-05-02-003-feat-nested-orchestration-v1`) for the goal-governance use case. Adds: (a) a pure triage classifier that maps a finding cluster to one of `{inline_fix, child_plan, follow_up_plan, operator_deferred}` per the Goal Governance V1 §3.3 + §6.4 rules; (b) goal-gap threshold constants (min findings per cluster, min severity, max child plans per parent pass, max nesting depth) next to the existing `DEFAULT_DEPTH_LIMIT`; (c) a private severity-rank table `_GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK` co-located with the goal-gap constants, NOT in `audit_writer.py` (D001 amendment — `audit_writer.py` stays focused on envelope writing); (d) typed input structures `GoalGapFinding` and `GoalGapClusterContext` (Pydantic models) for the classifier signature so F1 has a stable shape to consume; (e) a goal-gap child-charter template requiring `parent_objective_contract_id`, `gap_class`, `cluster_scope`, `severity`, `surfaces_affected`, and a non-empty `why_child_plan_not_feature` rationale; (f) explicit cap-enforcement helper `validate_goal_gap_child_plan_caps()` that the charter builder calls before producing a charter; (g) reuse of the existing return-condition parser without modification — `_LEGAL_STATUSES = {satisfied, blocked, superseded}` already covers goal-gap children (D007); (h) `evidence/goal-governance/<pass>/...` path convention as a module constant + helper; (i) `parse_goal_gap_fan_in_memo_fields()` as a SIBLING parser to the existing fan-in memo parser (NOT an extension — D001 amendment), reusing `parse_return_condition_section()` then validating goal-gap-specific required fields (`objective_contract_id:` and `gap_class_closed:`); (j) tests under `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_goal_governance_config.py`; (k) reference doc at `docs/GOAL_GOVERNANCE_F0_REFERENCE.md`. **Additive-only invariant** (D001 amended wording): no behavior changes to existing public APIs; no changes to existing Pydantic model fields; no changes to existing guard conditions (depth/cycle/signature); no changes to existing return-condition statuses; additive helpers/constants/templates/typed-structures only, plus `__all__` exports as needed. **No runtime spawning automation** — the classifier is a pure function; operator decides + invokes existing spawn machinery. Direct path (D008).
steps: Pre-flight: confirm baseline test sweep matches Plan E close-out (`PYTHONPATH=scripts python -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/ -p no:cacheprovider` returns 979 passed, 6 skipped). This is the regression floor.

Pre-flight: greppable confirmation that F0 will be additive — current `nested_orchestration.py` exposes `DEFAULT_DEPTH_LIMIT`, `_LEGAL_STATUSES`, `FAN_IN_MEMO_TEMPLATE`, `PRE_RESUME_GATE_PREFIX`, `_RETURN_CONDITION_HEADING_RE`, `_STATUS_LINE_RE`. Document baseline in F0 step evidence.

Add module-level threshold constants: `GOAL_GAP_MIN_FINDINGS_PER_CLUSTER = 3`, `GOAL_GAP_MIN_SEVERITY_FOR_CHILD_PLAN = 'medium'`, `GOAL_GAP_MAX_CHILD_PLANS_PER_PARENT_PASS = 3`, `GOAL_GAP_MAX_NESTING_DEPTH = 2` (with comment that this nests within the platform `DEFAULT_DEPTH_LIMIT = 3`). Co-located with `DEFAULT_DEPTH_LIMIT` so future maintainers see them as a related set.

Add module-level evidence path prefix constant: `GOAL_GOVERNANCE_EVIDENCE_PREFIX = 'evidence/goal-governance'`. Add helper `goal_governance_evidence_path(plan_dir: Path, pass_name: Literal['pre_impl', 'post_impl'], artifact: str) -> Path` that returns a normalized path under the prefix.

Add the private severity-rank table `_GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK = {'low': 0, 'advisory': 0, 'medium': 1, 'high': 2, 'critical': 3}` co-located with the goal-gap constants in `nested_orchestration.py`. **Do NOT add this in `audit_writer.py`** — that module stays focused on envelope writing (D001 amendment). Severity ordering follows the audit envelope schema; `advisory` and `low` both rank below `medium` (the threshold gate).

Define lightweight Pydantic models `GoalGapFinding` and `GoalGapClusterContext` for the classifier signature. `GoalGapFinding` minimum fields: `severity: str` (validated against `_GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK` keys via Pydantic field_validator — raises `ValueError` on unknown severity per D010), `subsystem: str`, `journey: str`, `finding_id: str`. `GoalGapClusterContext` minimum fields: `coherence_rule: Literal['subsystem_and_journey']` (only one rule today; v1), `explicitly_out_of_scope: bool` (caller-supplied flag for the `follow_up_plan` path), `existing_goal_gap_children: list[Any]` (used by the cap helper). Both models use `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` to match the rest of the codebase.

Add the triage classifier: `classify_goal_gap_cluster(findings: list[GoalGapFinding], cluster: GoalGapClusterContext) -> Literal['inline_fix', 'child_plan', 'follow_up_plan', 'operator_deferred']`. Pure function. Decision rules per Goal Governance V1 §3.3 + §6.4: (a) `child_plan` if cluster has ≥3 findings AND any finding ranks ≥ `_GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK['medium']` AND `cluster.coherence_rule == 'subsystem_and_journey'`; (b) `inline_fix` if cluster has 1-2 findings AND all rank below medium AND not `explicitly_out_of_scope`; (c) `follow_up_plan` if `cluster.explicitly_out_of_scope` is True; (d) `operator_deferred` otherwise (judgment call recorded in the audit envelope, not auto-classified). Unknown severity is impossible because Pydantic validation rejects it at construction time per D010.

Add the cap-enforcement helper: `validate_goal_gap_child_plan_caps(existing_goal_gap_children: list[Any]) -> None`. Raises `ValueError` if `len(existing_goal_gap_children) >= GOAL_GAP_MAX_CHILD_PLANS_PER_PARENT_PASS`. The charter builder (next step) calls this before producing a charter, so the cap is enforced at charter creation time, not at spawn time.

Add goal-gap child-charter template: `GOAL_GAP_CHILD_CHARTER_TEMPLATE` (multi-line string template) + `build_goal_gap_charter(parent_objective_contract_id: str, gap_class: str, cluster_scope: dict, severity: str, surfaces_affected: list[str], why_child_plan_not_feature: str, existing_goal_gap_children: list[Any]) -> str` builder. Builder: (a) calls `validate_goal_gap_child_plan_caps(existing_goal_gap_children)` first; (b) validates `severity in _GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK` (raises ValueError on unknown — D010); (c) validates `why_child_plan_not_feature` is non-empty and ≥20 chars (raises ValueError otherwise — D006); (d) returns the rendered charter.

Add `parse_goal_gap_fan_in_memo_fields(memo_path: Path) -> dict` as a SIBLING parser to the existing fan-in memo parser. The sibling internally calls `parse_return_condition_section()` to reuse status validation; then validates that goal-gap-specific required fields are present: `objective_contract_id:` and `gap_class_closed:`. Raises `ValueError` if either field is missing or empty. **Do NOT modify the generic fan-in parser** — touching it would risk regressing non-goal-gap plans (D001 amendment).

Verify return-condition parser handles goal-gap contracts WITHOUT modification: existing `_RETURN_CONDITION_HEADING_RE` + `_STATUS_LINE_RE` + `_LEGAL_STATUSES` already cover `{satisfied, blocked, superseded}` per the locked enum (D007 — no new statuses). F0 confirms goal-gap children using these statuses parse correctly. Add a test fixture exercising a goal-gap return condition through the existing parser.

Write tests at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_goal_governance_config.py` covering: (a) classifier returns correct class for each of the 4 cases; (b) classifier respects severity ordering (e.g., 5 advisory findings does NOT trigger child_plan); (c) classifier respects coherence rule (5 medium findings across different subsystems → NOT child_plan); (d) `GoalGapFinding(severity='bogus')` raises `ValueError` at construction time (D010); (e) charter builder rejects empty `why_child_plan_not_feature`; (f) charter builder rejects rationale shorter than 20 chars; (g) charter builder rejects unknown severity (D010); (h) `validate_goal_gap_child_plan_caps()` raises ValueError when called with a 3-element existing-children list (the 4th would be over the cap); (i) anti-recursion inheritance — a goal-gap charter past `DEFAULT_DEPTH_LIMIT` is refused via the existing depth guard; same for cyclic spawn; same for repeated-finding signature collision; (j) `parse_goal_gap_fan_in_memo_fields()` rejects memos missing `objective_contract_id:` or `gap_class_closed:`; (k) `goal_governance_evidence_path()` constructs the documented path shape.

Write reference doc `docs/GOAL_GOVERNANCE_F0_REFERENCE.md`: a single-page map of the constants + templates + typed structures F0 adds, with a section per deliverable cross-linked to GOAL_GOVERNANCE_V1.md sections (§3.3 triage, §6.3 coherence, §6.4 threshold, §9 Plan F0 acceptance). Audience: future maintainers reading either side and tracing to the other.
Run `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` on touched files. Run `python scripts/sanitization_check.py`. Both clean.
Run full orchestrate test suite. Confirm 979 + N (where N is the count of new tests added in step 12) passed, 6 skipped. Zero regressions in pre-existing tests.

Verify additive-only invariant (D001 amended wording): manual + greppable check that all of the following hold — (i) no behavior changes to existing public APIs in `nested_orchestration.py`; (ii) no field changes to existing Pydantic models (`ChildCharter`, `CommitPolicy`, etc.); (iii) no changes to existing guard conditions (depth/cycle/signature); (iv) no changes to existing return-condition statuses (`_LEGAL_STATUSES` unchanged); (v) only additive helpers/constants/templates/typed structures, plus `__all__` exports as needed. The git diff may show modified lines for `__all__` updates and import re-grouping; what matters is behavioral preservation, not line-by-line additivity.

Boundary check: `git diff --name-only HEAD` confined to (a) `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/nested_orchestration.py` (additive), (b) new file `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_goal_governance_config.py`, (c) new doc `docs/GOAL_GOVERNANCE_F0_REFERENCE.md`, (d) this plan dir `docs/plans/2026-05-05-002-feat-goal-governance-nested-orchestration-config/`. Zero diffs to historical plan dirs, scripts/ outside `dontpanic_orchestrate/`, or `claude/shared/`.

Write F001 close-out memo at `evidence/f001-closeout-memo.md` mirroring Plan E F002 closeout structure: deliverable-by-deliverable verification, before/after test counts, additive-invariant confirmation against the amended wording, queued-for-F1 note.
features.acceptance: (1) **Triage classifier exists, pure, and typed.** `classify_goal_gap_cluster(findings: list[GoalGapFinding], cluster: GoalGapClusterContext) -> Literal['inline_fix', 'child_plan', 'follow_up_plan', 'operator_deferred']` is a module-level function with no side effects. Greppable. (2) **Child-plan threshold codified per Goal Governance V1 §6.4:** classifier returns `child_plan` iff cluster has ≥3 findings AND ≥1 finding ranks ≥ medium AND `coherence_rule == 'subsystem_and_journey'`. Tested across all 4 cases including negative cases (5 advisory findings → not child_plan). (3) **Threshold constants present:** `GOAL_GAP_MIN_FINDINGS_PER_CLUSTER`, `GOAL_GAP_MIN_SEVERITY_FOR_CHILD_PLAN`, `GOAL_GAP_MAX_CHILD_PLANS_PER_PARENT_PASS`, `GOAL_GAP_MAX_NESTING_DEPTH`. Greppable. (4) **Severity rank table location:** `_GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK` is in `nested_orchestration.py`, NOT `audit_writer.py`. Greppable in both files. (5) **Typed input structures:** `GoalGapFinding` and `GoalGapClusterContext` are Pydantic models with `extra='forbid'`. `GoalGapFinding.severity` validates against `_GOAL_GAP_SEVERITY_RANK` keys at construction time; `GoalGapFinding(severity='bogus')` raises `ValueError` (D010). (6) **Goal-gap child-charter template + builder:** `build_goal_gap_charter()` requires all 6 input fields (parent_objective_contract_id, gap_class, cluster_scope, severity, surfaces_affected, why_child_plan_not_feature) plus `existing_goal_gap_children` for cap enforcement; raises ValueError if (a) cap exceeded, (b) severity is unknown, (c) `why_child_plan_not_feature` is empty or <20 chars. (7) **Cap-enforcement helper exists:** `validate_goal_gap_child_plan_caps(existing_goal_gap_children)` is a module-level function that raises ValueError when len ≥ `GOAL_GAP_MAX_CHILD_PLANS_PER_PARENT_PASS`. Tested directly + via charter builder. (8) **Anti-recursion inheritance:** goal-gap children still hit Plan 003's depth/cycle/signature guards. Test confirms a goal-gap charter past `DEFAULT_DEPTH_LIMIT` is refused; same for cyclic spawn; same for repeated-finding signature collision. (9) **Evidence path convention:** `GOAL_GOVERNANCE_EVIDENCE_PREFIX` constant + `goal_governance_evidence_path()` helper produce paths matching `evidence/goal-governance/{pre_impl|post_impl}/<artifact>`. Tested. (10) **Goal-gap fan-in sibling parser:** `parse_goal_gap_fan_in_memo_fields()` is a SIBLING to the existing fan-in memo parser, NOT an extension of it. It reuses `parse_return_condition_section()` for status parsing and rejects memos missing `objective_contract_id:` or `gap_class_closed:`. Existing generic fan-in memo parser is unchanged. (11) **Return-condition parser unchanged but verified:** existing `_LEGAL_STATUSES = {satisfied, blocked, superseded}` covers goal-gap children (D007 — no new statuses). Test fixture exercises a goal-gap return condition through the existing parser without modification. (12) **Unknown severity rejection (D010):** classifier never silently treats unknown severity as below threshold. Pydantic validation rejects at `GoalGapFinding` construction time; `build_goal_gap_charter()` rejects at builder time. Both paths tested with `severity='bogus'`. (13) **Tests added at `test_goal_governance_config.py`** covering classifier (all 4 cases + severity + coherence + unknown severity), charter validation (rationale rejection × 2 + unknown severity), cap helper (direct + via builder), anti-recursion, sibling fan-in parser, return-condition fixture, evidence path. (14) **Reference doc at `docs/GOAL_GOVERNANCE_F0_REFERENCE.md`** maps F0 additions to GOAL_GOVERNANCE_V1.md §3.3 / §6.3 / §6.4 / §9 sections with cross-links. (15) **Existing tests still green:** full orchestrate suite returns 979 + N passed, 6 skipped, where N is the count of new tests added (step 12). Zero regressions in pre-existing tests. (16) **Additive-only invariant (D001 amended wording):** all of — (i) no behavior changes to existing public APIs; (ii) no changes to existing Pydantic model fields; (iii) no changes to existing guard conditions (depth/cycle/signature); (iv) no changes to existing return-condition statuses; (v) additive helpers/constants/templates/typed structures only, plus `__all__` exports as needed. Verified by manual diff review + targeted grep. Modified lines for `__all__` updates and import re-grouping are acceptable; behavior preservation is the lock. (17) **Boundary preserved:** `git diff --name-only HEAD` confined to F0's own surface (nested_orchestration.py additive + new test file + new doc + this plan dir). Zero diffs elsewhere. (18) **Ruff + sanitization clean.** (19) **F001 close-out memo at `evidence/f001-closeout-memo.md`** with deliverable-by-deliverable verification + queued-for-F1 note.

evidence_refs.note: F001 implementation: additive GOAL_GAP_* constants, GoalGapFinding/GoalGapClusterContext Pydantic inputs, pure classify_goal_gap_cluster(), validate_goal_gap_child_plan_caps(), goal_governance_evidence_path(), goal-gap child charter builder, and sibling parse_goal_gap_fan_in_memo_fields(). Existing depth/cycle/signature guards and return-condition statuses are unchanged.
